description: This PHP class defines a PDF writer for PhpSpreadsheet that utilizes the TCPDF library to generate PDF files from spreadsheet data, including methods for setting up the PDF, configuring page layout, and saving the output to a file.

classes.name: Tcpdf
classes.description: A class extending the base PDF writer to generate PDFs using the TCPDF library, with capabilities to configure page layout, embed data from a Spreadsheet object, and output PDF files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TCPDF writer with a spreadsheet object and setting inline CSS usage.

methods.name: createExternalWriterInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of the external TCPDF library with specified orientation, unit, and paper size.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Prepares the spreadsheet for saving, configures PDF properties and layout, generates the PDF content, and writes it to a file.
